description: Keep a media server library with groups, then batch-import links, server JSON or an account notice into Rex / Forward / SenPlayer / Vidora / EplayerX.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 媒体库分组管理 + 批量导入：把导入链接、线路汇总 JSON、开通通知解析成 Rex / Forward / SenPlayer / Vidora / EplayerX 的导入，并可导入导出小幻影视（afusekt）格式。
localizedDescriptions.en: Media library group management + batch import: parse import links, line summary JSON, and activation notifications into Rex / Forward / SenPlayer / Vidora / EplayerX imports, and can import and export afusekt format.

name: EmbyLibraryKit
